ambiguities.detail: Zero @Controller REST routes in packages/core/src/api (grep-verified at SHA). The API surface is GraphQL, not REST. A REST-only detector FINDS 0 ROUTES HERE — that is the correct answer, not a detection failure. routes[] is deliberately empty; the boundary is encoded, never faked.

Public API = GraphQL operations: POST /<shopApiPath> (default 'shop-api') + POST /<adminApiPath> (default 'admin-api'); operations are @Query()/@Mutation()/@ResolveField() methods on 68 @Resolver classes (e.g. shop-auth.resolver.ts @Mutation() login with no name arg -> field 'login' by NestJS convention). Enumerating operations needs a NestJS-GraphQL detector (out of v0.1-alpha scope). Effective apiPaths are config-overridable -> Inferred.

packages/core/src/event-bus/, job-queue/ (BullMQ-style + separate Worker bootstrap in bootstrap.ts:278), scheduler/ — background flows, unknown statically.
